note: MODULES THE WALLET APPLICATION REACHES THAT THIS PACKAGE DOES NOT PUBLISH.
Every entry below is INTERNAL. None of them is in this package's `exports`
map and none of them is available to anybody who installs this package. The
wallet reaches them because it is built from this repository and its own
config aliases the package name at this folder's `src`, from source.
WHY THE LIST EXISTS RATHER THAN THE REACH BEING LEFT IMPLICIT. An alias that
quietly grants one consumer more than every other consumer gets is invisible
at the import site: `midnight-identity/keys/derivation` reads exactly like
`midnight-identity/profile/model`, and one of those is published and the
other is not. Somebody meeting the first a year from now has no way to tell,
and the natural repair - widening `exports` until the imports resolve for
everybody - publishes the key derivation, the passkey verification and the
recovery pieces as library API by accident.
SO THE LIST IS THE STATEMENT, AND `apps/wallet/internal-reach.test.ts` IS
WHAT KEEPS IT TRUE: it reads every import in the application, takes the ones
